label: atlantis_talk_04_friend_01
text: What’re your parents like, Nemona?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_04_rival_01
text: My parents? Normal, I guess.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: atlantis_talk_04_botan_01
text: Are you serious? Even I know about your dad.\nHe’s on the board of the Rotom Phone company![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_04_rival_02
text: Wait, how do you know that?![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: atlantis_talk_04_botan_02
text: Everyone knows that. He’s famous. And I guess\nI looked into him for my own reasons, too.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_04_friend_02
text: So Nemona’s actually some pampered little\nprincess from a rich family?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_04_rival_03
text: Ugh! No! No way! That’s so not my thing.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: atlantis_talk_04_rival_04
text: Though, yeah...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: atlantis_talk_04_rival_05
text: I guess you could say Mother and Father were,\nlike...hands-off but in a good way?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: atlantis_talk_04_rival_06
text: My big sister’ll probably take over the business,\nso they pretty much let me do what I wanted.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: atlantis_talk_04_friend_03
text: Wait, you call them “Mother” and “Father”?![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_04_botan_03
text: That is some pampered little princess stuff\nright there.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_04_rival_07
text: Gaah! Cállate, Penny! What, is your family super\nnormal, then?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: atlantis_talk_04_botan_04
text: M...my family is...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_04_botan_05
text: unbelievably annoying...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_04_rival_08
text: Like super overprotective, you mean?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: atlantis_talk_04_botan_06
text: It’s just my dad! He’s loud and clingy and makes\nup weird nicknames for me, like “Pen-pen.”[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_04_botan_07
text: He’s the most annoying guy in the world! Period!\nHe’s the worst![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_04_friend_04
text: Man, that’s a real downer...for your dad.\nHaving his own daughter describe him like that...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_04_botan_08
text: Don’t you dare take his side![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: atlantis_talk_04_rival_09
text: Uhhhhhh...[VAR 0x0100(0000)]! How ’bout you?\nYour mother seemed super nice.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: atlantis_talk_04_friend_05
text: You met her?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: atlantis_talk_04_rival_10
text: Yup! Got a glimpse of an amazing-looking\nsandwich she made, too![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: atlantis_talk_04_friend_06
text: Really? Wish I could’ve seen that. I bet it tasted\ngreat...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
